source: Income Tax Department (incometaxindia.gov.in), read 17 Oct 2026: 'Tax treatment of Gifts Received by an Individual or HUF' (Income-tax Act, 2025, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026); Income-tax Act, 2025, sections 92, 186 and 451; Income-tax Rules, 2026, rule 15(5)(a), Table IV, item 4; threshold-limits page. Rules as printed, not tax advice.

beats.vo: Friends' money gifts above fifty thousand rupees a year: all of it taxable.

spots.geo: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

beats.name: Limit
beats.text: in a tax year, in total. Above it, the whole sum is taxable.
beats.sub: New Income-tax Act, 2025. Year 2026-27. A gifted TV is not counted.
beats.vo: The limit counts a whole tax year's money gifts from non-relatives.

beats.name: Example
beats.text: two gifts, all of it taxable
beats.vo: Two gifts of twenty-five and twenty-eight thousand: all fifty-three thousand is taxable.

beats.name: Employer
beats.text: a tax year in gifts or vouchers: below it, valued at nil
beats.sub: Income-tax Rules, 2026. An older page shows ₹5,000 for gifts in kind.
beats.vo: Employer gifts under fifteen thousand rupees a year count as nil value.

beats.name: Cash
beats.text: or more in a day, or for one occasion: only through a bank
beats.sub: Cheque, draft or electronic mode. A penalty can equal the sum received.
beats.vo: Two lakh or more from one person a day: bank only.

beats.note: 'Relative' is a list defined in the Act. The department's rules, not advice on anyone's tax.
beats.vo: Relatives' gifts and your own wedding gifts: not taxed. Diwali: no exemption.
Did you know the fifty thousand rupee rule? Comment below.
